per_seed.route: refusal (calibrate's 2.5 px residual limit, reached before the LOO gate)
per_seed.reason: REFUSED before writing a metric: Equally-valued ticks on a log or linear axis are equally spaced in PIXELS. Unequal spacing means these positions are not tick marks -- most often glyph centroids of the axis labels, whose spacing tracks the label text, not the axis. That is error class 20. Re-detect the ticks from the darkness-weighted centroid of the columns OUTSIDE the axis rule.

REFUSED before writing a metric: errors.DetectionError: detect_bar_windows: did not find 12 bar windows at any probe row. This is a REFUSAL. Do not fall back to an assumed pitch -- an assumed grid is error class 28, a detector miss falling through to a literal.
correctly moved nothing: 12/12 bar values identical. The harness does not credit 'any change exits non-zero'.

emit_refusals.literal_confidence: raises: emit: confidence='high' is a LITERAL.
emit_refusals.caveat_without_a_note: raises: emit_rows('seed') item 'X': this row carries a caveat (confidence='low', positional_ambiguity='', structure_assumed='', value_is_bound='') and its curation_note is empty.

P8_emission.z_over: one z per experiment; one cell type, one cargo, one timepoint, one formulation -- error class 22 cannot arise

P9_benchmarks.question: do the field's benchmark lipids top this screen?
P9_benchmarks.but_the_comparison_is_CONFOUNDED: the formulation (DOPE 30.5 / chol 32 / PEG 2.5) was selected as the winner of an 18-member screen run on C12-200. SM-102 and ALC-0315 are evaluated in a formulation optimised for a different ionizable lipid, so the ranking is not a clean chemistry comparison. Recorded on the row and in DECISIONS.
P9_benchmarks.all_three_are_universal_controls: C12-200, SM-102 and ALC-0315 are the field's benchmark lipids and all three are already in the corpus. 3 of 3 shared lipids are controls -- CLAUDE.md section 8's hazard in its purest form.

measured_sensitivity_limits.scale: 1 px = 11.26 axis units; the smallest emitted value (1179.1) is 105 px tall, so a 1 px read error is 0.96% of it
measured_sensitivity_limits.error_bar_caps: the widest cap covers 0.6269 of its bar against the 0.90 gate -- margin 0.2731. A cap wider than 0.90 would leak; none here is.
measured_sensitivity_limits.control_72h: bars.bar_top refuses it. The bar is ~3 px tall and the refusal is recorded as a refusal, never as a zero.
measured_sensitivity_limits.dose: Fig 4G's pDNA dose is stated nowhere in the SI and the article is paywalled. Dose_ug_nucleicacid is BLANK (F-004's posture), not reconstructed from Fig 3B.
